title: PCA-Enhanced Adaptive NVAR Framework for High-Resolution Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting in the East Sea
abstract: arXiv:2606.12141v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of sea surface temperature (SST) is essential for marine ecosystem monitoring, climate assessment, fisheries management, and operational ocean forecasting. While numerical ocean models provide reliable predictions, they are computationally expensive, and conventional machine learning methods often suffer from high-dimensional inputs and error accumulation during long-term autonomous forecasting. This study extends our previously proposed Adaptive Nonlinear Vector Autoregression (Adaptive NVAR) framework to high-resolution real-world SST prediction by integrating Principal Component Analysis (PCA) through Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Daily SST fields from the GLORYS12V1 reanalysis dataset covering the East Sea, Yellow Sea, and East China Sea are compressed into a lower-dimensional latent representation that preserves the dominant spatial variability. translated_title: 基于PCA增强的自适应NVAR框架用于日本海高分辨率海表温度预测
translated_abstract: 海表温度（SST）的精确预测对海洋生态系统监测、气候评估、渔业管理以及业务化海洋预报至关重要。尽管数值海洋模式能够提供可靠的预测，但其计算成本高昂；而传统机器学习方法则常因高维输入以及长期自主预报中的误差累积问题而表现受限。本研究通过引入基于奇异值分解（SVD）的主成分分析（PCA），将我们此前提出的自适应非线性向量自回归框架扩展至高分辨率真实世界的海表温度预测。来自GLORYS12V1再分析数据集、覆盖日本海、黄海和东海的逐日海表温度场被压缩为能够保留主导空间变率的低维潜在表示。所提出的降阶框架利用……进行评估（原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 本研究将基于SVD的PCA降维与自适应非线性向量自回归（Adaptive NVAR）框架相结合，有效压缩高分辨率海表温度场数据，克服了传统方法的误差累积问题，实现了对日本海等海域长期、低计算成本且准确的海表温度预测。
en_tdlr: This study enhances the Adaptive NVAR framework with SVD-based PCA dimensionality reduction, enabling accurate, computationally efficient, and stable long-term high-resolution sea surface temperature forecasting in the East Sea.
